prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity UI design comp for approval, NOT a photograph, NOT an implemented screenshot.
Reference image 1 is the existing QuoDex dual-reservoir cockpit and is the immutable visual identity and content reference. Reference image 2 is the existing Pro single-reservoir variant and is supporting identity evidence only; do not mix the two reservoir layouts. Use the dual-reservoir cockpit from image 1 as the one main widget.
Preserve the exact existing cockpit proportions, cyan glass edge, curved reservoirs, Segoe-like system typography, CODEX badge, 5 HOUR 18% LEFT, WEEK 95% LEFT, reset labels and the bottom quota/network strip. Do not redesign the cockpit or move its internal information. The existing widget has logical dimensions 300x130. Render its material faithfully at large readable scale.
The only new product region is a transparent space adjacent to the cockpit for individual Codex chat-task circles. Background is visible directly through this region. No large filled card, no opaque toolbar, no separate titled task panel. No task labels or counts permanently inside the widget.
Exactly THREE task circles are visible in the main example, one per chat: the FIRST TWO are RUNNING, using cyan incomplete thin circular rings with a short brighter sweep segment and a transparent dark center; the THIRD is COMPLETED, using a clear emerald-green outlined circle with a legible emerald-green check mark inside and a very faint translucent green center. Running rings have no percentage because progress is indeterminate. Logical circle diameter 20px, minimum hit target 28px, spacing 10px. Give the completion circle enough contrast that the green check is readable.
Each task glyph is smaller and visually quieter than the reservoir percentages. This is a small always-on-top desktop widget, not a dashboard. No invented menus, no navigation, no big headings inside the widget. Glass-web approximation, not a claim of official Apple rendering.
Produce a clean landscape design review image on a dark slate-blue desktop backdrop with one soft brighter area behind the widget so the transparency can be judged. Front-on, no perspective tilt, no dramatic 3D pedestal. Main widget centered and large enough to inspect. A modest label at the upper left outside the widget identifies the option. A caption at the bottom outside the widget reads exactly "UI CONCEPT / SAMPLE TASK DATA". All design annotations outside the application bounds.
Option A. Outside-widget title exactly "A / BELOW". Place the three task circles in a centered horizontal row in NEW TRANSPARENT SPACE BELOW the cockpit, separated from its glass edge by 8 logical px. All three are equally spaced. The full app bounds would be about 300x164 logical px; the cockpit remains 300x130. The transparent task region is reserved space so a second row can fit later, not an opaque shelf. Do not put the circles in the existing network/footer strip, do not cover quota text. This is the recommended visual composition, discreet and balanced.
